summary: fix(auth): normalize PostgreSQL URL scheme for asyncpg dialect
decisions: Add _normalize_pgsql_url() to convert postgres:// and pgsql:// schemes to postgresql+asyncpg://

bugs.symptom: NoSuchModuleError: Can't load plugin: sqlalchemy.dialects:postgres on deployment
bugs.root_cause: ACCOUNT_POSTGRESQL_URL env var uses postgres:// scheme; SQLAlchemy dialect name is postgresql not postgres
bugs.fix: Normalize URL scheme in create_pgsql_engine() before passing to create_async_engine()

summary: chore: remove unused test suite and pytest config
decisions: Remove 7 stale test files (1436 lines) that are no longer maintained
Remove [tool.pytest.ini_options] from pyproject.toml as tests directory is gone

summary: fix(auth): strip sslmode from PostgreSQL URL and build SSL context for asyncpg
decisions: Add _prepare_pgsql_url() to normalize URL scheme and extract sslmode query param
Build ssl.SSLContext from sslmode value and pass via connect_args to asyncpg
asyncpg does not accept sslmode kwarg ¡ª must use ssl parameter with SSLContext object

bugs.symptom: TypeError: connect() got an unexpected keyword argument sslmode
bugs.root_cause: asyncpg driver does not recognize libpq-style sslmode URL query parameter
bugs.fix: Strip sslmode from URL, build ssl.SSLContext, pass via connect_args={"ssl": ctx}
